newsitem.title: USA: W.House -- CPI suggests economy can sustain growth.
newsitem.headline: W.House -- CPI suggests economy can sustain growth.

text.p: News that consumer prices rose only 0.1 percent in January shows that the U.S. economy is strong and can continue to grow for some time to come, the White House said Wednesday.

"It shows the fundamental strength of an American economy that continues to grow at an acceptable pace with low levels of inflation, low levels of unemployment and with the basic fundamentals that encourage the President to believe that we can sustain economic growth for some time to come," White House spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters during a trip to Boston by President Clinton.
